handSideMarked.visualCheck: Hero right-facing attack with Leo's magenta annotation marking the intended punching-hand path; the circled retracted hand is the arm that must extend across the torso to the screen-right fist.
handSideMarked.forbidden: NPC identity, face, hair, clothes, palette, proportions, or direction

userHandShapeFix.visualCheck: Leo-provided corrected frame: punching arm, retracted hand, pose, and style are accepted; only deterministic cutout/size/center processing is allowed.
userHandShapeFix.allowed: source pixels, background removal, 240x320 normalization, full alpha>32 centroid recenter
userHandShapeFix.forbidden: semantic redraw, changing either hand, attack phase, direction, identity, clothing, feet, scale, or framing

walk_1.semantics: walking phase 1: full-body stride, one leg forward and the other back, arms counter-swing, feet separated and planted

walk_2.semantics: walking phase 2: opposite stride from phase 1, full-body motion, opposite leg forward, arms counter-swing

atk_1.semantics: attack phase 1: guarded charging pose, both fists drawn close to the chest, elbows bent, feet planted

atk_2.semantics: attack phase 2: one closed fist extends toward screen right while the other fist retracts near the torso, feet planted
